LineageOS 23.2 is here, bringing Material 3 Expressive, UI refinements, camera upgrades, and an increasingly rare feature in 2026: an Android experience without built-in AI.

In this review, we look at what's new, what's improved, and whether LineageOS is still the best custom ROM for extending the life of your phone.
